summary: All 4 UI-facing criteria for the navigation drawer footer fix verified via browser checks. No backend/API surface for these criteria, so no backend test files were needed.

checks.criterion: Menu footer text is visible in the embedded preview layout (990x780)
checks.name: menu-footer-visible-embedded-990x780
checks.evidence: At 990x780, opened drawer via open-menu-button; navigation-drawer-footer bounding box fully within viewport (y>0, y+height<=780) after transition settled; innerText contained 'HELLO@BDSM.CO' and 'BDS MARVEL'. Screenshot: footer-990x780.png

checks.criterion: Menu footer appears after navigation without overlap (desktop + mobile)
checks.name: menu-footer-no-overlap-nav-desktop-mobile
checks.evidence: At 1280x720 and 390x844, navigation-drawer-footer.boundingBox().y >= navigation-menu bottom edge (navBottom); all 7 nav-*-link testids visible. Screenshots: desktop-1280x720.png, mobile-390x844.png

checks.criterion: Menu footer remains visible across representative screen sizes
checks.name: menu-footer-visible-across-sizes
checks.evidence: Footer text fully within viewport bounds at 1280x720, 990x780, 390x844, 844x390. CSS display verified: flex (one-line) at widths >800px (1280, 990, 844x390 landscape - width-based breakpoint), block (stacked) at 390x844 (width<=800). Screenshots for all 4 sizes.

checks.criterion: Drawer remains usable after responsive compression
checks.name: drawer-usable-after-responsive-compression
checks.evidence: At 375x700: all 7 nav items visible+enabled, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth<=clientWidth+1), close-menu-button removes menu-drawer--open class, zero console errors and zero >=400 network responses captured during flow. Screenshots: drawer-open-375x700.png, drawer-closed-375x700.png

notes: Initial run of menu-footer-visible-embedded-990x780 failed due to my own test timing (measured bounding box before the .55s CSS slide-in transition completed, y=-81). Added expect.poll to wait for transition settle; re-ran and it passed cleanly - classified as flaky/test-timing, not an app bug.

844x390 was initially asserted to use stacked (mobile) layout but the app's CSS breakpoint is width-based (max-width:800px), so 844px width correctly renders the desktop one-line layout. Adjusted expectation to match actual (correct) CSS behavior - not a bug.
Matrix has exactly 4 criteria, all UI-facing with no distinct API surface; no backend test files were applicable.
